observations.behavior: Adds a typed choices class for feedback classification.
observations.posthog_connection: Provides shared constants and validation support for distinguishing feedback categories.

observations.behavior: Adds an optional choice field to request serialization with explicit allowed values.
observations.posthog_connection: Allows backend API consumers to distinguish between bugs, features, and general feedback while rejecting invalid types.

observations.behavior: Conditionally appends the feedback_type parameter only when provided in client requests.
observations.posthog_connection: Supports backward compatibility by omitting the new field from older clients or those without this capability.

observations.limitations: All changes are contained within the desktop feedback submission flow; no broader system behavior is demonstrated.

review.limitations: All changes are contained within the desktop feedback submission flow; no broader system behavior is demonstrated.
review.reason: The change adds a bounded, substantive improvement: structured input handling and type discrimination for feedback submissions, including tests and compatible conditional transmission. This does not demonstrate systemic risk reduction across components.
review.posthog_relevance: Helps PostHog team classify user-reported issues more reliably at ingestion, potentially improving downstream routing and triage workflows.
review.uncertainty: None; all hunks are complete and relevant.
